# homeassistant_config (Data Source)

Reads the configuration of the Home Assistant instance (`GET /api/config`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "homeassistant_config" "this" {}

output "home_assistant_version" {
  value = data.homeassistant_config.this.version
}

output "has_mqtt" {
  value = contains(data.homeassistant_config.this.components, "mqtt")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `components` (List of String) Loaded components (integrations and platforms), sorted.
- `elevation` (Number) Elevation of the location, in meters.
- `latitude` (Number) Latitude of the location.
- `location_name` (String) Name of the location.
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude of the location.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`.
- `unit_system` (Attributes) Units the instance displays values in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unit_system))
- `version` (String) Home Assistant version, e.g. `2026.11.0`.

<a id="nestedatt--unit_system"></a>
### Nested Schema for `unit_system`

Read-Only:

- `length` (String) Length unit, e.g. `km`.
- `mass` (String) Mass unit, e.g. `g`.
- `temperature` (String) Temperature unit, e.g. `°C`.
- `volume` (String) Volume unit, e.g. `L`.
